issues.description: The page is rendering step-1 content (room type selection with 6 buttons) on the step-2 URL (/design/step-2). Step-2 should show a 2x2 grid of 4 style images for the first anchor question after a room has already been selected. The room selection UI should only appear at step-1.
issues.element: Entire page content / room selection grid
issues.root_cause: The step-2 page component is either (1) not receiving the selected room from state/context and falling back to rendering the room selection UI again, or (2) the router is rendering the Step1 component at the /design/step-2 route, or (3) the step-2 component conditionally renders the room selector when no room is selected in state, but since navigating directly to /design/step-2 without first completing step-1 leaves state empty, it shows the room picker instead of redirecting. The console logs show page:mount event for 'step-2' so the correct component is mounting, but the UI renders the room selection fallback branch.

issues.description: No style images (2x2 grid) are displayed. Step-2 is supposed to show 4 anchor style images loaded from Supabase storage for anchor question 1 of 3. These images are completely absent.
issues.root_cause: Because the page is rendering the room-selection fallback UI instead of the anchor-question UI, the image grid component is never rendered. Additionally, if a room type is not in context/state, the image-fetching logic may never be triggered. Images may also fail to load from Supabase if the bucket URL or public access policy is misconfigured, but the primary issue is the wrong UI branch being rendered.

issues.description: The progress indicator shows 'STEP 1 OF 4' instead of 'STEP 2 OF 4'. The URL is /design/step-2 so the header step counter is wrong.
issues.element: STEP 1 OF 4 text in top-right header
issues.root_cause: The step counter in the header is either hardcoded to 1 in the step-2 component, or the component that renders the header is receiving the wrong step prop/value. If the Step2 component is re-using the Step1 layout without updating the step number, this would produce the wrong label.

issues.description: The scroll offset warning 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position' appears in console logs. This does not affect functionality critically but indicates a positioning issue with a scrollable container component.
issues.root_cause: A scroll-tracking library or custom scroll hook is being used on a container element that has default static CSS positioning. The container needs position: relative, fixed, or absolute.

fixes.reason: Instead of rendering the room selector fallback when no room is selected, redirect the user back to step-1. This prevents step-2 from showing step-1 UI and ensures proper flow. Requires useRouter and useEffect imports.
The step counter should use a dynamic currentStep prop/variable rather than hardcoded '1'. The step-2 page should pass currentStep={2} to the layout component.
The step-2 page is passing currentStep={1} to the layout, causing the header to display 'STEP 1 OF 4'. It should pass 2.
Fixes the console warning about scroll offset calculation requiring a non-static positioned container.
